participant_id.Description: BIDS label = patient ID of the release (P001-P029)

age.Description: Age at surgery (release clinical information table)

age_of_onset.Description: Age at epilepsy onset (release table; n/a where the table has a backslash)

mri.Description: MRI finding as coded in the release table (P / N; the release does not define the codes, presumably positive / negative)

n_electrodes.Description: Number of implanted SEEG electrodes (release table)

therapy.Description: Surgical therapy (release table: Resection / Ablation / Ablation & Resection)

ez_channel_ids.Description: Channel-level EZ annotation: channel numbers as listed in the release file "channel level EZ annotations.xlsx". The release does not say whether the numbers index the channel order of the .mat files (1-based) or the original montage; they are copied verbatim. P014: the release row is identical to P007's (EZ and deleted lists) and 9 of its numbers exceed P014's channel count; probably copied from P007 in the release (see README).

deleted_channel_ids.Description: Deleted channels (bad contacts), channel numbers verbatim from the same release file (same caveat)
